A high-stakes Serie A encounter on May 3, 2026 , saw two of Italy’s most competitive sides trade blows in a match defined by momentum shifts and clinical finishing. Both clubs searched for supremacy in a contest that kept the supporters on the edge of their seats until the very last second. Bologna’s Early Command Bologna began the afternoon with aggressive intent, needing only nine minutes to break the deadlock. Juan Miranda turned provider with a pinpoint pass to Federico Bernardeschi , who composed himself to fire a left-footed shot into the back of the net. The momentum was firmly with the hosts, and they nearly doubled their lead shortly after when Juan Miranda rattled the post with a fierce strike that had the SSC Napoli defense scrambling. The pressure eventually led to a decisive VAR intervention in the 32nd minute. After reviewing a challenge by Giovanni Di Lorenzo on Juan Miranda , the referee awarded a penalty. Riccardo Orsolini stepped up in the 34th minute and, despite Vanja Milinkovic-Savic getting a hand to it, the power of the strike ensured the ball found the net to make it 2-0. Napoli Strike Back Just as Bologna seemed to be cruising toward halftime, SSC Napoli found a lifeline. In the second minute of first-half stoppage time, Giovanni Di Lorenzo reacted quickest to a loose ball in the box, stabbing it home to reduce the deficit. The goal revitalized the visitors, who emerged for the second half with renewed vigor. Only three minutes after the restart, Napoli were level. Rasmus Højlund showcased his vision to find Alisson Santos , who clinicaly finished with his right foot to make it 2-2. The game then descended into a tense tactical battle, characterized by several yellow cards, including bookings for Jhon Lucumí and Matteo Politano , as both sides fought for every inch of grass. Rowe’s Moment of Magic As the match entered the 90th minute, the stage was set for a hero. In the first minute of added time, substitute Jonathan Rowe produced a moment of pure brilliance. Connecting with a cross in the box, Rowe launched into a spectacular bicycle kick, sending the ball past the keeper to restore Bologna's lead in breathtaking fashion. SSC Napoli threw everything forward in the final moments, with Amir Rrahmani seeing a late header saved by Massimo Pessina . Despite the late pressure and a flurry of corners, the home side held firm to secure a 3-2 victory, leaving the fans at the stadium breathless after a true football spectacle.
